title: R3G: A Reasoning-Retrieval-Reranking Framework for Vision-Centric Answer Generation
abstract: arXiv:2602.00104v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-centric retrieval for VQA requires retrieving images to supply missing visual cues and integrating them into the reasoning process. However, selecting the right images and integrating them effectively into the model's reasoning remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose R3G, a modular Reasoning-Retrieval-Reranking framework. It first produces a brief reasoning plan that specifies the required visual cues, then adopts a two-stage strategy, with coarse retrieval followed by fine-grained reranking, to select evidence images. On MRAG-Bench, R3G improves accuracy across six MLLM backbones and nine sub-scenarios, achieving state-of-the-art overall performance. Ablations show that sufficiency-aware reranking and reasoning steps are complementary, helping the model both choose the right images and use them well. We release code and data at https://github.com/czh24/R3G.

translated_title: R3G：一种面向视觉中心答案生成的推理-检索-重排序框架
translated_abstract: 面向视觉问答（VQA）的以视觉为中心的检索需要检索图像以提供缺失的视觉线索，并将其整合到推理过程中。然而，如何选择合适的图像并将其有效地融入模型的推理过程仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这一难题，我们提出了R3G，一个模块化的推理-检索-重排序框架。该框架首先生成一个简短的推理计划，明确所需的视觉线索，然后采用两阶段策略——先进行粗检索，再进行细粒度重排序——来选择证据图像。在MRAG-Bench上，R3G在六个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）骨干和九个子场景中均提升了准确率，取得了最先进的整体性能。消融实验表明，充分性感知重排序与推理步骤是互补的，能够帮助模型既选对图像，又用好图像。我们在 https://github.com/czh24/R3G 发布了代码和数据。
tldr: R3G提出了一种模块化的推理-检索-重排序框架，通过先生成推理计划再执行两阶段（粗检索+细粒度重排序）的图像证据选择，在MRAG-Bench上跨六个MLLM骨干和九个子场景实现了最先进的视觉问答性能。
